result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and modern curb ramps with tactile warning strips, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the lack of visible pedestrian-specific signals at this signalized junction and potential sightline obstructions from the adjacent wooded embankment reduce the overall safety of the environment.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian signal heads are present at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular traffic lights.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The steep embankment and dense vegetation on the corner may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Pavement Cracking
hazards.description: Visible cracking in the asphalt surface near the crosswalk area could present a minor trip hazard or indicate maintenance needs.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and accessible push buttons to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Vegetation and Sightline Management
interventions.description: Trim trees and manage the embankment vegetation to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair the cracked asphalt within the intersection to provide a smooth, hazard-free surface for all users.
